options.content:
### Reference data browser — hierarchy, PackML routing, POs, shifts
Low-churn configuration read straight from Postgres F1 (`public`): **enterprise → site → area → equipment**, the `packml_register` SparkPlug topic routing, production orders + their runtime segments, and shift definitions. Scoped by the **$enterprise/$site/$area/$equipment** chain. `packml_register.active = true` is what oeecloud requires to route a topic; `shift_hours.begin_time/end_time` are **seconds from `week_begin`**, not clock times.

targets.rawSql: SELECT id_enterprise, nm_enterprise, active FROM enterprises WHERE id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) ORDER BY nm_enterprise

SELECT s.id_site, ent.nm_enterprise, s.nm_site FROM sites s JOIN enterprises ent ON ent.id_enterprise = s.id_enterprise WHERE s.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND s.id_site IN ($site) ORDER BY ent.nm_enterprise, s.nm_site

panels.title: Areas
panels.description: week_begin = seconds offset from Monday 00:00 (can be negative); week_size = shift-calendar span.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.id_area, ent.nm_enterprise, s.nm_site, a.nm_area, a.week_begin, a.week_size FROM areas a JOIN sites s ON s.id_site = a.id_site JOIN enterprises ent ON ent.id_enterprise = a.id_enterprise WHERE a.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND a.id_site IN ($site) AND a.id_area IN ($area) ORDER BY ent.nm_enterprise, s.nm_site, a.nm_area

panels.title: Equipments
panels.description: tp_equipment: 1=Machine, 2=Sector, 3=Line. lead_machine = the machine that generates downtime events for a sector/line.

targets.rawSql: SELECT eq.id_equipment, ent.nm_enterprise, s.nm_site, a.nm_area, eq.nm_equipment, CASE eq.tp_equipment WHEN 1 THEN 'Machine' WHEN 2 THEN 'Sector' WHEN 3 THEN 'Line' ELSE eq.tp_equipment::text END AS tp_equipment, eq.status_type, eq.ideal_speed, eq.lead_machine, lm.nm_equipment AS nm_lead_machine FROM equipments eq JOIN areas a ON a.id_area = eq.id_area JOIN sites s ON s.id_site = eq.id_site JOIN enterprises ent ON ent.id_enterprise = eq.id_enterprise LEFT JOIN equipments lm ON lm.id_equipment = eq.lead_machine WHERE eq.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND eq.id_site IN ($site) AND eq.id_area IN ($area) AND eq.id_equipment IN ($equipment) ORDER BY ent.nm_enterprise, s.nm_site, a.nm_area, eq.nm_equipment

panels.title: PackML register — topic routing
panels.description: Maps SparkPlug B topics → equipment. active=true means oeecloud processes this topic. id_unit = id_equipment for machines (tp_equipment=1).

targets.rawSql: SELECT pr.id_packml_register, ent.nm_enterprise, s.nm_site, a.nm_area, e.nm_equipment, pr.packml_topic, pr.active, pr.id_unit, pr.signal_quality, pr.timestamp FROM packml_register pr JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment = pr.id_equipment JOIN areas a ON a.id_area = e.id_area JOIN sites s ON s.id_site = e.id_site JOIN enterprises ent ON ent.id_enterprise = e.id_enterprise WHERE pr.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND pr.id_site IN ($site) AND pr.id_area IN ($area) AND pr.id_equipment IN ($equipment) ORDER BY ent.nm_enterprise, s.nm_site, a.nm_area, e.nm_equipment

SELECT po.id_production_order, ent.nm_enterprise, s.nm_site, a.nm_area, e.nm_equipment, po.status, po.nm_production_order, po.ts_start, po.ts_end, po.production_final FROM production_orders po LEFT JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment = po.id_equipment LEFT JOIN areas a ON a.id_area = po.id_area LEFT JOIN sites s ON s.id_site = po.id_site LEFT JOIN enterprises ent ON ent.id_enterprise = po.id_enterprise WHERE po.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND po.id_site IN ($site) AND po.id_area IN ($area) AND po.id_equipment IN ($equipment) ORDER BY po.id_production_order DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Production order runtimes
panels.description: One row per PO run segment. Open ts_end = currently running. recalc_needed=true triggers re-processing by the engine.

targets.rawSql: SELECT por.id_production_order_runtime, po.nm_production_order, po.status AS po_status, e.nm_equipment, lower(por.runtime_timerange) AS ts_start, upper(por.runtime_timerange) AS ts_end, por.net_production, (por.gross_production - por.net_production) AS scrap, por.recalc_needed FROM production_orders_runtime por JOIN production_orders po ON po.id_production_order = por.id_production_order LEFT JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment = por.id_equipment WHERE po.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND po.id_site IN ($site) AND po.id_area IN ($area) AND por.id_equipment IN ($equipment) ORDER BY por.id_production_order_runtime DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Shifts & shift hours
panels.description: begin_time/end_time are seconds from week_begin (Monday 00:00 = 0). begin_day_time/end_day_time render them as a weekday clock for readability. Area shifts take priority; site shifts are the fallback.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sh.id_shift, s.nm_site, a.nm_area, sh.cd_shift, TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW()) + (sh2.begin_time || ' seconds')::interval, 'Dy HH24:MI') AS begin_day_time, TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW()) + (sh2.end_time || ' seconds')::interval, 'Dy HH24:MI') AS end_day_time, sh2.begin_time, sh2.end_time FROM shifts sh JOIN sites s ON s.id_site = sh.id_site LEFT JOIN areas a ON a.id_area = sh.id_area JOIN shift_hours sh2 ON sh2.id_shift = sh.id_shift WHERE s.id_site IN ($site) ORDER BY sh.id_shift, sh2.begin_time
